content.text:
Warehouse capacity-limit errors now return 429 instead of 500, and `go test ./...` passes.

The cause was in `errcatalog/warehouse.go`. The key `"warehouse.limit"` was mapped to `api.CodeInternal`, which `api.HTTPStatus` turns into 500. Every other domain maps its `.limit` key to `api.CodeQuota`, which gives 429. I changed that one entry to `api.CodeQuota` and left all other mappings alone.

I didn't add a test for this mapping.
